instruction: turn on the front right burner of the stove
press the start button on the microwave
turn off the sink faucet
pick the lime from the pan and place it on the plate
pick the peach from the counter and place it in the sink
pick the water bottle from the counter and place it in the cabinet
pick the lime from the cabinet and place it on the counter
open the microwave door
pick the mug from the counter and place it under the coffee machine dispenser
press the button on the coffee machine to serve coffee
close the cabinet doors
close the left drawer
turn on the sink faucet
turn the sink spout to the right
turn off the front left burner of the stove
press the stop button on the microwave
pick the avocado from the sink and place it on the plate located on the counter
pick the sweet potato from the microwave and place it on plate located on the counter
pick the egg from the plate and place it in the pan
pick the corn from the counter and place it in the microwave
open the right drawer
open the cabinet doors
close the cabinet door
pick the mug from under the coffee machine dispenser and place it on the counter
